share_app_text:
Ikaze muri Vitaway Plus!

Vitaway ni urubuga rw'ubuzima rugufasha kwikurikirana no kwivuza unyuze murandasi. Kugenzura ibipimo by'ubuzima nk'amaraso, ibiro, isukari mumaraso, n'ibindi byoroshye. Gira ibiganiro kuri murandasi hamwe n’abajyanama b’ubuzima b'inzobere, abaforomo, n’abaganga kugira ngo baguhe ubufasha bwihariye n’inama. Ganira nabo binyuze kuri video, amajwi n’ubutumwa. Bika inyandiko zo kwa muganga aho zitabura kugira ngo abaganga bacu babanze bazisuzume mbere yo kubonana. Fata ubuyobozi ku buzima bwawe hamwe na Vitaway uyu munsi.

🔑 Ibyingenzi:
- Gukurikirana ubuzima
- Ibipimo by’ubuzima
- Kugenzura amaraso
- Ibiro
- Kugenzura glucose y’amaraso
- Guhura kuri murandasi
- Umujyanama w'ubuzima
- Gufashwa n’abaforomo
- Gufashwa n’abaganga
- Ibyiganiro bya video
- Ibyiganiro by'amajwi
- Inyandiko z’ubuzima
- Gusigasira ubuzima
- Ubuyobozi bw’ubuzima

Sobanukirwa byinshi kandi tangira hamwe na Vitaway Plus hano: https://bit.ly/4c99Nwk

#VitawayPlus #IkurikiranaUbuzima #UbufashaBwoKurandasi #UbuyoboziBwUbuzima
intro_text: Vitaway helps you live well with diabetes, high blood pressure and related conditions, with support from a care team in Rwanda.
nutrition_text: Log your glucose, blood pressure, weight and medicines in a few taps, and see how you are doing over time.
care_text: Your Vitaway coach and clinic team see the readings you share, answer your messages and book your reviews, by phone, video or at the Vitaway clinic.
seamless_care_text: Short lessons, reminders and a plan you choose help you build small daily habits. If you need care in person, your team will tell you where to go.
personal_care_text: Your coach follows your progress and plans next steps with you. Vitaway does not replace emergency care: in an emergency, call 912.
subscription_text: Vitaway is free to download. Some services, such as coaching and clinic reviews, need a paid plan or a sponsor. The app shows the price before you pay.
secure_confidential_text: Your health information is kept private. It is shared only with your care team and the people you allow.
stay_on_top_text: Questions or feedback? We would love to hear from you.
feedback_text: Vugana n'ikipe ya Vitaway. Kanda ku cyo ushaka.
